description: Text-free KOVA bucket and sunrise company mark, extracted from the original reception plaque. Centered transparent 512px canvas.
Opaque warm-paper company desktop wallpaper with a quiet repeating KOVA bucket silhouette. No readable text; subtle deterministic paper grain.
Paper OS window with manila title bar, navy perimeter and quiet body. Top border protects title bar and inner rule corners. Body content inset [40,108,560,324]. No baked controls or text.
Stationery taskbar strip with quiet paper center and manila rim; runtime app buttons and status sit above it.
Quiet cream paper notification with navy outline and inset stationery rule. No colored side stripe. Runtime icon and localized message supplied separately.
Blank desktop app tile in the original manila-and-paper control style. The icon and localized name are runtime overlays.
Paper-colored office-bean pointing cursor with green cuff. Hotspot [27,7], source pixels; full hand remains inside the 64px canvas.
Transparent screen fault: irregular navy static with an unplugged cable and empty socket motif. No text, glow or decorative stripe. Full-screen 1920x1080 overlay.

Transparent coffee damage overlay: large dark pooled spill obscures the central screen, irregular splash droplets and dry cup-ring stain. Restrained flat brown tones; real alpha outside and within the spill.
